info.title: MoloTalk public API
info.description:
Публичный контракт MoloTalk. Источник — proto; документ сгенерирован.
Register, Login и RefreshToken не требуют access token.

connect-protocol-version.title: Connect-Protocol-Version
connect-protocol-version.description: Define the version of the Connect protocol

code.description: The status code, which should be an enum value of [google.rpc.Code][google.rpc.Code].

message.description: A developer-facing error message, which should be in English. Any user-facing error message should be localized and sent in the [google.rpc.Status.details][google.rpc.Status.details] field, or localized by the client.

details.description: A list of messages that carry the error details. There is no limit on the number of messages.

type.description: A URL that acts as a globally unique identifier for the type of the serialized message. For example: `type.googleapis.com/google.rpc.ErrorInfo`.

value.description: The Protobuf message, serialized as bytes and base64-encoded. The specific message type is identified by the `type` field.

debug.title: Debug
debug.description: Deserialized error detail payload. The 'type' field indicates the schema. This field is for easier debugging and should not be relied upon for application logic.

connect.error_details.Any.description: Contains an arbitrary serialized message along with a @type that describes the type of the serialized message, with an additional debug field for ConnectRPC error details.

google.protobuf.Timestamp.description: A point in time in RFC 3339 format, with up to nanosecond precision. Output uses UTC (`Z`); input may use an offset from UTC.

molotalk.v1.GatewayEnvelope.title: GatewayEnvelope
molotalk.v1.GatewayEnvelope.description:
At most one of `identify`, `ready`, `heartbeat`, `heartbeatAck`, `serverEvent` may be set.

Exactly one of `identify`, `ready`, `heartbeat`, `heartbeatAck`, `serverEvent` must be set.

sizeBytes.title: size_bytes
sizeBytes.description: Общий предел вложения — 20 МиБ; предел аватара проверяет доменное правило.

molotalk.v1.PublicProfile.title: PublicProfile
molotalk.v1.PublicProfile.description: Публичный профиль события не содержит identifier.

molotalk.v1.ReceiptUpdated.title: ReceiptUpdated
molotalk.v1.ReceiptUpdated.description:
Автор получает receipt_summary, сеансы читателя — собственный receipt.

Exactly one of `receiptSummary`, `receipt` must be set.

password.title: password
password.description: Состав пароля проверяет Auth; контракт ограничивает только длину.

molotalk.v1.ServerEvent.title: ServerEvent
molotalk.v1.ServerEvent.description:
At most one of `messageCreated`, `messageUpdated`, `messageDeleted`, `receiptUpdated`, `chatChanged`, `membershipChanged`, `profileChanged`, `presenceChanged` may be set.

Exactly one of `messageCreated`, `messageUpdated`, `messageDeleted`, `receiptUpdated`, `chatChanged`, `membershipChanged`, `profileChanged`, `presenceChanged` must be set.

displayName.title: display_name
displayName.description:
Отсутствие поля сохраняет текущее значение; явное false в clear_avatar
 означает удаление аватара и отличается от отсутствия поля.
